wanted to share 2 methods of relief for Tinnitus that seemed to have helped me...

my Tinnitus is the result of exposure to very loud noise, including what was apparently a flash-bang grenade (military, basic training), gunfire and work related - the noise in my ears is very high pitched and constant, 24/7

i started researching this horrible condition hoping to find at least some degree of relief and have noticed the following....

a) anything that raises blood pressure seems to increase the noise - eating large meals, salt

b) silver hydrosol (ionic silver) applied in the ear canal does nothing

**one very important note regarding D.E.**; there are different types (apparently two) and if you try this **you want the food grade D.E.**, not the stuff used in pool filters!
